title: The botanical type foundry
alt: The word GROW is carved in pale stone, with ferns and white blossoms emerging from its cracks.
description: Readable sculptural typography combines stone, living plants and precise material detail.
prompt: A sophisticated sculpture photograph of the word GROW formed by four large freestanding letters carved from pale stone. Fresh ferns, white blossoms and tiny trailing leaves emerge from narrow cracks in the stone while the complete letter shapes remain perfectly readable. G, R, O and W stand in that order on one long dark slate plinth. The letters cast coherent shadows in soft morning light; microscopic stone grain and delicate botanical detail, refined gallery atmosphere, sage green and ivory palette, no other text.
